caption: Water is poured into a clear jug standing in front of a patterned tile wall, and the pattern seen through the jug shifts as the water rises.

sa.check: A clear jug stands in front of a patterned tile wall.
The pattern seen through the jug shifts as the water rises.
The boundary of the shift is at the water level.

pc.expect: The pattern looks different behind the filled part than behind the empty part, with the boundary at the water level.
pc.fail: The pattern is the same above and below the water; or the boundary is away from the water level; or the shift is beside the jug.

pc.expect: The wall itself does not change.
pc.fail: The tiles move; or the pattern changes; or a different wall appears.

pc.expect: The water level rises steadily while pouring.
pc.fail: It falls while pouring; or jumps; or is full before the pour.

pc.expect: The stream falls as liquid and the jug is rigid.
pc.fail: The stream is a rod; or the jug bends; or the water goes opaque.

pc.expect: One jug, and water comes only from the pour.
pc.fail: Water appears with no stream; or the jug duplicates; or water passes through the jug.

pc.expect: The tiles' colours and the jug stay the same.
pc.fail: The tiles change colour; or the jug changes shape; or the counter changes.
